design_origin: agent-owned test design; not requester wording; chosen independently before any repo/catalog/research reads

randomization.method: uniform secrets.choice from 5 public indoor places, 3 adult roles, 3 events using general knowledge only
randomization.place: 도심 공공 수영장의 실내 분실물 접수 창구
randomization.event: 인쇄된 안내지와 벽의 방향 표지가 서로 다른 방향을 가리키는 순간

subject: one clearly adult 29-year-old woman; dry everyday rain jacket and plain crew-neck top; attached image is visible face/hair reference only, with no inference of original age, identity, character, proportions, health, or desire
composition: waist-up environmental portrait at eye height, head yaw no more than 15 degrees, 75-85mm-like perspective; both hands and full face visible; tiled public-pool lost-property desk with numbered locker-key tags, tray holding one rolled swim cap, folded floor guide lying on desk and a wall directional arrow pointing differently; fluorescent-neutral room light plus soft window side fill
independent_neutral_forms: both eyes remain visibly open; upper eyelids partially lowered, subject-left upper eyelid visibly lower than subject-right
irises displaced toward subject-right side while face remains nearly frontal; no whole-eye closure
narrow central lip gap, thin upper-incisor edge visible, subject-left mouth corner subtly raised relative to subject-right
right index fingertip touches her own right lower cheek beside mouth, with clear local contact and slight cheek displacement
left index fingertip is raised near her own left temple but separated by a visible 4-6 cm air gap; no self contact on that side
natural_action: the guide is already on the counter; she has paused between comparing the flat printed guide and the wall arrow; hands are free and independently visible

pre_render_gates.expected: single explicitly adult-looking subject in dry street clothing at recognizable indoor public-pool lost-property counter; guide and different-oriented wall arrow both visible
pre_render_gates.fail: missing desk/guide/arrow relation or replacement by glamour/swimwear scene

pre_render_gates.expected: both eyes visibly open with iris/pupil visible; subject-left upper lid covers more of iris than subject-right by observable margin
pre_render_gates.fail: equal fully open eyes, complete wink, closed eyes, squint dominated by lower lids
pre_render_gates.unobservable: blur, occlusion, too small, head angle preventing comparison

pre_render_gates.expected: pupils/irises shifted toward subject-right relative to near frontal head
pre_render_gates.fail: gaze straight into lens or in opposite direction; head turn substituted for iris shift
pre_render_gates.unobservable: eye detail cannot locate irises reliably

pre_render_gates.expected: a narrow central inter-lip opening exposes a thin upper-incisor edge while subject-left corner is a little higher than right
pre_render_gates.fail: fully closed lips, broad grin, wide open mouth, symmetric corners, glossy highlight alone mistaken as a gap/tooth
pre_render_gates.unobservable: resolution/occlusion prevents separation of tooth and highlight or corner height

pre_render_gates.expected: right index fingertip in direct visible contact with own right lower cheek beside mouth; local indentation/displacement supports contact
pre_render_gates.fail: hovering finger, contact with lips/chin instead, other hand, finger merely overlaps silhouette
pre_render_gates.unobservable: contact point hidden or too soft to resolve

pre_render_gates.expected: left index fingertip near own left temple, separated by visible 4-6cm air gap; ownership clear
pre_render_gates.fail: touches temple/hair/face, detached hand ownership ambiguous, gap absent or hand missing
pre_render_gates.unobservable: cropped finger/temple or depth alignment hiding gap

pre_render_gates.expected: attached image used only for visible face and hair appearance; resulting subject remains expressly adult in request and final scene
pre_render_gates.fail: reference replaced by unrelated face/hair, added inferred identity/character/body proportion
pre_render_gates.unobservable: likeness cannot be established from output/ref comparison

pre_render_gates.expected: all required gates pass in the same original generated image
pre_render_gates.fail: any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE in required gates; partial_is_fail

scoring: strict all-of; partial_is_fail; no inference of thoughts, intent, attraction, consent, health or relationship from forms
independence: No other arms, current active data, previous research, candidate pack, or fixture read before this record.
